items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Oh, Amos Riley, I used to play with him too.

ctx.x: See, a long time ago when we were playing music, we could play in a big hole like that, we'd play about two pieces and take about fifteen minutes, you know, intermission. And some of them, good bands, take a half an hour, you know. But now you get there, you gotta play. That's my house wasn't at it. Just like a Jitney dance. That's the way to play it. I tell you that on them now. We didn't ask him about Amos Riley. The sign? Amos Riley. Oh, Amos Riley, I used to play with him too. He did, he been to him.
